precedence: this amendment overrides only the listed missed-interaction and mapping clauses

attachment.eligible: first actual open-to-close gripper transaction after arm motion with a frozen attachment-capable semantic root detected
attachment.intervention: execute the physical close while suppressing simulator attachment for that transaction and restore only the detected unattached rigid root if contact friction displaced it
attachment.effect: the frozen semantic root is absent from selected-gripper attachments and any restored rigid root is within 0.001 m of its pre-close position

maintained_contact.eligible: first actual open-to-close transaction after arm motion with a validated Panda-finger-to-active-drawer contact candidate
maintained_contact.intervention: apply open amount 1.0 for that gripper transaction without moving the drawer or changing the arm path
maintained_contact.effect: actual open amount exceeds 0.9 and no validated Panda-finger-to-active-drawer contact or attachment exists after the transaction

forbidden: declaring Open Drawer missed-interaction effective merely because no attachment exists
restoring or translating an articulated drawer shape
using proximity-only evidence as maintained contact
expanding gripper contacts beyond the four frozen Panda finger collision shapes
